import mmap, os, tempfile
P = 4096
N = 4096 * P
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cow-cross-batch-') as d:
    fd = os.open(d + '/backing', os.O_CREAT | os.O_RDWR | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    os.ftruncate(fd, N)
    area = mmap.mmap(fd, N, flags=mmap.MAP_PRIVATE, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE)
    ranges = [(254*P, 515*P), (1024*P, 2048*P), (4094*P, N)]
    for start, end in ranges:
        area[start:end] = b'7' * (end-start)
    expected = bytes(area)
    child = os.fork()
    if child == 0:
        try:
            assert area[:] == expected
            area[0:P] = b'C' * P
            nested = os.fork()
            if nested == 0:
                assert area[0:P] == b'C' * P and area[P:] == expected[P:]
                area[254*P] = 99
                os._exit(0)
            assert os.waitpid(nested, 0) == (nested, 0)
            assert area[254*P] == 55
            area[254*P] = 88
            os._exit(0)
        except BaseException:
            os._exit(42)
    assert os.waitpid(child, 0) == (child, 0)
    assert area[:] == expected
    area.close()
    assert os.pread(fd, N, 0) == bytes(N)
    os.close(fd)
print('COW_COPY_BATCH_BOUNDARIES_OK', flush=True)
